I booked the "Launch retro" for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). All five attendees are free for the full hour.

Ember is on floor 0 of the North building, seats 6, and has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder. It was the only option that met every constraint. The other video-conference rooms that seat five or more (Atlas and Grove) were booked for the whole afternoon, and the attendees had no other common free hour that morning.

I took the calendars' local times as headquarters time, since they all show the same UTC-5 offset.

content.text:
I booked the 'Launch retro' for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in **Ember** (R-EMBER, North building, floor 0). Booking ID: BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh, Dev Patel and Eli Novak. Everyone is free for the full hour.
- **Room:** Ember seats 6, so it fits all five, and it has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder.

I treated headquarters time as the same as the attendees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC-5), since all five are based at headquarters.

This was the only slot that worked. The other rooms with video conferencing and enough seats (Atlas and Grove) were booked all afternoon, and no other slot was free for all five people.

transcript.content: Today is 2026-11-02. Book a 60-minute 'Cross-site sync' on 2026-11-03 for Priya Nair (P-PRI, New York), Tom Hale (P-TOM, London) and Sven Berg (P-SVE, Berlin). Meeting times are in headquarters time, which is New York (UTC-5). All three must be free and inside their own local 09:00-17:00 working hours, and the room must seat all three and have video conferencing. Meetings start on the hour or half hour.

**Rooms:** Only three rooms seat at least five people and have video conferencing: Ember (6), Atlas (8) and Grove (10).
- **Ember:** booked 09:00–10:30 and 15:00–17:00, so both windows are blocked.
- **Atlas:** booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00, so both windows are blocked.

**Options if you can relax one requirement:**

- **Kite (South, floor 3, seats 16, projector, no video conferencing):** free 16:00–17:00.

If you'd rather keep video conferencing, the other option is to move the meeting to another day. Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking BK-9901). Cedar is on the North building's 3rd floor and has a projector and whiteboard. It seats 12, which is more than the four attendees you need.

I checked each attendee's calendar and the room bookings for that day. Cedar was the only room with a whiteboard and enough seats that also met the 15-minute room buffer in the policy. The attendees' only shared free time was 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30, because Dev is busy from 14:30. The 13:00 slot failed in every whiteboard room because of neighbouring bookings and the buffer.

I treated the calendars' times as headquarters time, since all four show the same UTC−5 offset. If headquarters runs on a different offset, the booking time would need to change.

- **Guest window:** The meeting ends at 14:30, inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.

This was the only slot that worked. Ember is busy 09:30–11:30 and 14:30–16:00. Ben has a 1:1 at 13:00–13:30. The ground-floor room Maple is booked until 12:00 and again from 13:00 to 14:30, so it had no 60-minute gap that fit the guest window.

The other rooms failed on the buffer rule, the whiteboard or capacity requirement, or because the Grove room is booked all day.

content.text: The new booking is confirmed, so I'll cancel the original 10:00 booking.

The Q4 planning meeting on 2026-11-03 has moved to Dune (R-DUNE) from 15:00 to 16:30 headquarters time, with all five attendees: Ana, Ben, Chloe, Dev and Eli. The new booking is BK-9901 and the original 10:00 booking (BK-7731) is cancelled.

Why this slot: Eli is busy 10:00–13:00 and everyone else is busy 10:00–11:30, so 15:00–16:30 was the only 90-minute window that was free for all five within working hours. Dune has a whiteboard and seats six. Cedar and Lark were ruled out because they clash with other bookings in that window.

The original meeting was fortnightly. I cancelled booking BK-7731 by its ID, and the system did not say whether that removed only the 3 November occurrence or the whole series. Please check the series in the calendar system.

I issued a refund of $84.75 (refund ID RF-0001) on order ORD-72144 for the wrong item. It goes back to her original payment method, PayPal. Policy says refunds settle within five working days.

- **Which order:** Dana Whitley has three orders with a walnut cutting board. ORD-72144 is the only one still inside the 30-day refund window. It was delivered 2026-10-09. The other two were delivered 2026-05-24 and 2026-08-24, so both are past the window.
- **Boards:** $76.00, which is 2 boards at $38.00 each. The olive oil tin was correct, so it isn't refunded.
- **Shipping:** $8.75, refunded in full because she is on the gold tier.

The order record shows a promo code, AUTUMN15, but the order total doesn't reflect any discount. I refunded at full unit price as the policy says.

I booked "Launch retro" for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 headquarters time in Ember (booking BK-9901).

- **Attendees:** Ana, Ben, Chloe, Dev and Eli are all free then and within their 09:00–17:00 working hours.
- **Room:** Ember seats 6 and has video conferencing, so the remote stakeholder can join.
- **Why this slot:** It is the only 60-minute slot where all five are free and a room that fits them has video conferencing.
  - The other free window for the group, 09:30–10:30, has no suitable room. Ember, Atlas and Grove are all taken then.
  - Ember is booked until 13:30 and Atlas from 13:30, so 13:00–14:00 doesn't work either.
  - After 14:30 at least one of the five is always busy.

I booked "Cross-site sync" for 2026-11-03 from 10:00 to 11:00 headquarters time (booking BK-9901). The room is Ember, which seats 6 and has video conferencing.

Local times for each attendee:
- **Priya Nair (New York):** 10:00–11:00.
- **Tom Hale (London):** 15:00–16:00.
- **Sven Berg (Berlin):** 16:00–17:00. The meeting ends right at the end of his working day.

This is the only 60-minute slot where all three are free and inside their own 09:00–17:00 hours:
- **Window:** Sven's working day ends at 11:00 headquarters time, and Priya's starts at 09:00, so the meeting has to fall between those times.
- **9:00 start:** Priya has a standup from 9:00 to 9:30.
- **9:30 start:** Sven has a standup from 9:30 to 10:00 headquarters time (15:30–16:00 Berlin).

Ember is free from 10:00 to 11:00. The other rooms with video conferencing that seat three or more (Haven, Birch, Atlas and Grove) are already booked then.

I booked "Cross-site sync" for 2026-11-03 from 10:00 to 11:00 headquarters time (booking BK-9901) in Ember. Ember seats 6 and has video conferencing.

- **Local times:** that is 10:00 for Priya in New York, 15:00 for Tom in London and 16:00 for Sven in Berlin. All three are inside their 09:00–17:00 working hours.
- **Why this slot:** the three working-hour windows only overlap from 09:00 to 11:00 headquarters time. Priya is busy until 09:30 and Sven is busy 09:30–10:00, so 10:00–11:00 was the only free hour.
- **Why Ember:** it was the only room with video conferencing, enough seats and no booking at that time. Birch, Haven, Atlas and Grove were all booked then.

content.text:
I booked the Process workshop (booking BK-9901) in Cedar, North building, floor 3. It runs on 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 for Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev.

- **Room:** Cedar has a whiteboard and seats 12, so it fits four people.
- **Attendees:** All four are free from 10:30 to 12:00. That is inside their 09:00–17:00 working hours, and it ends before their 12:00 lunch.
- **Policy:** The 15-minute room buffer holds. Cedar's earlier booking ends at 10:00, which is 30 minutes before the start. Its next booking starts at 14:00, 2 hours after the end.
- **Other rooms:** I checked the other rooms that have a whiteboard and seat four or more. Each one conflicted with an existing booking or its 15-minute buffer, or didn't fit the attendees' free time. Grove is booked all day.
- **Time zone:** The attendees' calendars are in New York time (UTC-5), and no tool gives the headquarters offset. I assumed headquarters time matches theirs, so the booking uses the same clock times. If headquarters is on a different offset, the time needs checking.

I booked the Process workshop (booking BK-9901) for 2026-11-03, 10:30–12:00, in Cedar (North building, floor 3). Cedar has a whiteboard and a projector, and it seats 12.

- **Attendees:** Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev are all free then and inside their 09:00–17:00 working hours. Their lunch blocks start at 12:00, so the workshop ends as lunch begins.
- **Policy:** The room policy requires a 15-minute gap between bookings in the same room. Cedar's nearest bookings are the "Standup overflow" ending at 10:00 and "Board prep" starting at 14:00, so the gap is met. The smaller rooms with a whiteboard (Birch, Fern, Dune, Lark) all clashed with an existing booking or its buffer in the times when all four attendees are free.
- **Time zone:** The system doesn't state what time zone headquarters is in. All four attendees' calendars are in US Eastern time (UTC−5), so I treated headquarters time as the same. If headquarters is in a different zone, the booking time needs rechecking.

I booked the "Northwind demo" (booking BK-9901) for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember, North building, floor 0. It seats 6.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor are the two booked attendees. The Northwind guest isn't listed, as you asked.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.
- **Policy:** The room is on the ground floor, as the policy requires for external guests. The slot also stays clear of the 12:00–13:00 midday blackout.
- **Conflicts:** Ember is free at that time. Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30. Ana's next meeting starts at 14:30.
- **Other ground-floor option:** Maple, the only other ground-floor room that seats three, had no free slot that fit.

I couldn't find the headquarters time zone in any system. Ana's and Ben's calendars are in New York time (UTC-5), and I assumed headquarters uses the same time. If it doesn't, the booking time needs rechecking.

I booked the 90-minute Process workshop for 2026-11-03, 10:30–12:00, in Cedar (booking ID BK-9901).

- **People:** Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev are all free then and inside their 09:00–17:00 working hours. Their lunch blocks start at 12:00, so there's no overlap.

content.text:
I moved Q4 planning to 15:00–16:30 on 2026-11-03 in Dune (booking BK-9901). Eli Novak is now an attendee along with Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev.

- **Time:** 15:00–16:30 is the only 90-minute window where all five are free within working hours (09:00–17:00). Eli is in training from 10:00 to 12:00, and Ana has a meeting at 14:00. The 13:00–14:00 gap is only an hour.
- **Room:** Dune is on North floor 1 and seats 6. It has a whiteboard and is free at that time. The other whiteboard rooms that fit five people were taken: Grove all day, and Cedar and Lark during that slot.
- **Time zone:** All five calendars are in New York time, which matches the old 10:00 booking, so I treated that as headquarters time.
- **Old booking:** I cancelled BK-7731 (Birch, 10:00–11:30) first.
- **Not carried over:** The old booking was marked as fortnightly. The new one is a single meeting with no recurrence, and I didn't set it up to repeat.

I booked the "Northwind demo" for 2026-11-03, 13:30–14:30 headquarters time, in Ember (booking ID BK-9901). Ember is on the ground floor (North building, floor 0) and seats 6. The attendees listed are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor. The Northwind guest isn't listed because they have no calendar here.

- **Policy:** External guests need a floor-0 room, and meetings can't overlap the 12:00–13:00 blackout. This slot meets both rules and falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.
- **Room:** The only ground-floor rooms that seat three or more are Ember and Maple. Maple was booked 13:00–14:30, so Ember was the one that worked.
- **Attendees:** Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30, and Ana's next meeting starts at 14:30. Both are free for the whole slot.
- **Time zone:** Ana's and Ben's calendars are in New York time (UTC-5), and I couldn't find the headquarters offset in the system. I assumed headquarters time matches theirs. The booking tool accepted the slot, but it's worth checking if headquarters is in a different time zone.

I routed the three open tickets in the 'intake' queue. I routed each one on its product area and category, not on the subject wording, as the routing rules require. I didn't touch any other ticket.

| Ticket | Product area / category | New queue |
|---|---|---|
| T-3103 ("Export to CSV failing") | `payments_api` | payments |
| T-3101 ("Login page broken after payment") | `auth` | identity |
| T-3102 ("Invoice shows the wrong amount") | `reports`, category `billing_dispute` | billing |

- **T-3103:** The subject mentions a CSV export, but the body describes the charge endpoint returning a 500, so payments is the right queue.
- **T-3101:** The subject mentions payment, but the problem is the sign-in page looping, so it goes to identity.
- **T-3102:** The `billing_dispute` rule sends it to billing whatever the product area.

content.text:
I closed two tickets as duplicates, following policy DP-2026-1. A duplicate needs a resolved ticket with the same product area and the same error code.

- **T-4103** is closed as a duplicate of T-4090. Both are in the auth product area with error code SSO-114.
- **T-4101** is closed as a duplicate of T-4100. Both are in the webhooks product area with error code WH-429.

I left two similar-looking tickets open because they don't meet the policy:
- **T-4104** has the same error code, SSO-114, as T-4090. But it's in the mobile_app product area, not auth.
- **T-4102** says it's the same issue as before and is in the webhooks area. But its error code is WH-503, not WH-429.

The only resolved tickets are T-4090 and T-4100, and no other open ticket matches either one. I didn't touch any other open ticket.

I escalated T-5101 ("Payment webhooks delayed") and no other ticket.

It is an urgent ticket from an enterprise customer (Lumen Energy). It was created at 08:30 and has had no first response, so the clock has run for 3.5 hours against a 1-hour target.

I checked the other open tickets with no first response against their plan and priority targets, and none has breached yet. The closest were T-5105 (enterprise, normal), which is at 6 hours against an 8-hour target, and T-5104 (pro, high), which is at 3 hours against 4. I didn't look up plans for the tickets that already have a first response. Their response times (all 2.5 hours or under) are within the target for any plan except the enterprise-urgent one, and T-5117, the only urgent ticket among them, was answered in 20 minutes.

content.text:
I escalated T-5101 ("Payment webhooks delayed"). It is the only open ticket that has breached its first-response SLA, and I escalated nothing else.

It is an urgent ticket on an enterprise plan, so the target is 1 hour. It was created at 08:30 UTC and still has no first response. By 12:00 UTC the clock has run 3.5 hours.

I checked the other 17 open tickets against the policy using each customer's plan and priority. None of the others has exceeded its target. The closest was T-5105, an enterprise normal-priority ticket, at 6 of its 8 allowed hours.

One oddity in the data: T-5101's customer record shows a "customer since" date of 2026-11-21, which is in the future. I used the plan listed on the ticket (enterprise) and did not treat that date as a problem.

I checked the other 17 open tickets against the target for their plan and priority. All are within their targets, including those that already have a first response. The one closest to its limit is T-5105 (enterprise, normal priority, no response yet), which is at 6 of its 8 hours.
